title: Supreme Court flags need for more commercial courts, seeks State-wise data
summary: The Supreme Court has sought State-wise data on pending commercial cases and the infrastructure available to commercial courts, highlighting the importance of speedy resolution of commercial disputes.

title: Karnataka tells Supreme Court bike taxis raise safety and insurance concerns
summary: The Karnataka government has challenged a High Court ruling concerning bike-taxi operations before the Supreme Court, raising issues relating to passenger safety, insurance coverage and women's safety.

title: Lok Sabha passes Tribunals Reforms Bill, 2026
summary: The Lok Sabha passed the Tribunals Reforms Bill, 2026 on August 10. The legislation concerns the statutory framework governing tribunals.

title: Supreme Court permits Abhishek Banerjee to travel abroad for eye treatment
summary: The Supreme Court permitted Abhishek Banerjee to travel abroad for three weeks for medical treatment, subject to conditions concerning travel and disclosure of itinerary and place of stay.

title: Supreme Court seeks Union and Assam replies on NRC identity cards plea
summary: The Supreme Court directed the Union Government and Assam to file replies in petitions concerning identity cards for persons included in the National Register of Citizens list published in 2019.

title: Supreme Court lists final hearing on challenge to Gurmeet Ram Rahim Singh acquittal
summary: The Supreme Court has listed for final hearing a plea challenging the Punjab and Haryana High Court's acquittal of Gurmeet Ram Rahim Singh in the journalist murder case.

title: Collegium recommends Justice Ashwani Kumar Mishra as Chief Justice of Punjab and Haryana High Court
summary: The Supreme Court Collegium has recommended Justice Ashwani Kumar Mishra for appointment as Chief Justice of the Punjab and Haryana High Court.

title: Collegium recommends Justice V Kameswar Rao as Chief Justice of Patna High Court
summary: The Supreme Court Collegium has recommended Delhi High Court Justice V Kameswar Rao for appointment as Chief Justice of the Patna High Court.

title: Collegium recommends Justice RV Ghuge as Chief Justice of Calcutta High Court
summary: The Supreme Court Collegium has recommended Justice Ravindra V Ghuge of the Bombay High Court for appointment as Chief Justice of the Calcutta High Court.

title: Centre notifies appointment of 15 judges to Madras High Court
summary: The Central Government has notified the appointment of 15 judges to the Madras High Court, comprising advocates appointed as judges and judicial officers appointed as additional judges.

title: Plea before Supreme Court challenges mid-cycle rollout of NCAHP regulations
summary: A plea before the Supreme Court challenges the mid-cycle rollout of newly notified National Commission for Allied and Healthcare Professions regulations for the 2026-27 academic session.

title: Justice N Kotiswar Singh highlights mediation opportunities for younger lawyers
summary: Justice N Kotiswar Singh highlighted the potential of mediation for younger lawyers and called for stronger mediation training in law colleges and universities.

title: CJI Surya Kant highlights compliance benefits of mediated settlements
summary: Chief Justice of India Surya Kant highlighted the role of mediation in dispute resolution and discussed research concerning compliance with settlements reached through mediation.

title: Delhi High Court criticises questions concerning a victim's clothing in sexual harassment case
summary: The Delhi High Court criticised questions concerning a victim's clothing during proceedings in a sexual harassment matter and addressed the relevance of such questions to the proceedings.

title: Madras High Court grants relief in case concerning video alleging police foisted false cases
summary: The Madras High Court dealt with a criminal case concerning a video alleging that police had foisted false cases against Muslims and granted relief in the matter.

title: Supreme Court adjourns Shiv Sena UBT plea concerning MPs' merger
summary: The Supreme Court adjourned the Shiv Sena UBT plea challenging the Speaker's decision concerning the merger of six MPs with the Shinde faction.

title: Supreme Court upholds compensation against TV Today for revealing child sexual abuse survivor's identity
summary: The Supreme Court dismissed TV Today's challenge to a Delhi High Court order directing compensation for disclosure of the identity of a child sexual abuse survivor, reinforcing the legal protection of survivors' privacy.

title: Centre notifies appointment of 30 judges to four High Courts
summary: The Central Government has notified the appointment of 30 judges and additional judges to the Madras, Calcutta, Madhya Pradesh and Karnataka High Courts.

title: Delhi High Court Justice Prathiba M Singh calls for judiciary-controlled AI platform
summary: Justice Prathiba M Singh highlighted the potential of artificial intelligence in legal work while raising concerns about privacy and the need for judicial control over AI systems used in the justice system.

title: Supreme Court takes up plea seeking reforms in drug enforcement under NDPS Act
summary: The Supreme Court has taken up a plea seeking reforms in drug enforcement under the Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act, bringing issues concerning investigation and enforcement practices before the Court.

title: Allahabad High Court rules on AIBE requirement for advocates with provisional enrolment
summary: The Allahabad High Court considered the position of advocates who obtained provisional enrolment and the requirement to clear the All India Bar Examination within the prescribed period in order to continue practising.

title: Bar Council of India announces proposed National Legal Academy in Goa
summary: The Bar Council of India has announced plans for a proposed National Legal Academy at the IIULER campus in Goa, with compulsory professional training for lawyers forming part of the initiative.

title: Bombay High Court examines effect of IBC amendment on pending personal-guarantor cases
summary: The Bombay High Court considered the effect of an Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code amendment removing the interim moratorium for personal guarantors and its application to pending proceedings.

title: Supreme Court addresses legal protection of child sexual abuse survivors' identity
summary: The Supreme Court's decision involving disclosure of a child sexual abuse survivor's identity highlights the continuing importance of statutory and constitutional protections for privacy and dignity in sensitive criminal proceedings.

title: Supreme Court Collegium recommends new Chief Justices for multiple High Courts
summary: The Supreme Court Collegium has recommended appointments for Chief Justices of several High Courts, including the Patna, Calcutta, Bombay and Punjab and Haryana High Courts.

title: Supreme Court publishes fresh court notices and institutional updates
summary: The Supreme Court's official website has published fresh notices concerning court numbers, oral mentioning matters and listing-related changes for August 2026.
